notes.title: The First Update Is Now Available
notes.content: As we promised, we've already released our first update today. In this version you can find out that the AI players are more reality, and we've added the number of AI players so you can still have fun when there's not that many real players.

notes.title: The First Update
notes.content: The first update will come on November 15th. In this version, we will improve the behavior of the AI players to make them looks less dummy.  And we will keep improve the game until we think it's good enough for you guys, so don't hesitate to leave messages to help us know what you guys want.
